name: Build an AI [💻 HACK]
desc:
🤖 BUILD AN AI 🤖 Build a datacenter. Train your AI. Hack everyone else. 💻

🏗️ Start with one old laptop… and grow it into a MASSIVE datacenter!
⚡ Buy servers & GPUs to train your AI from Tiny Model all the way to AGI! 🧠
📊 Scrape data, level up, and spend Skill Points on Money, Hacking or Security!

😈 HACK other players! Walk up to their servers, plug in your USB, and steal their cash! 💰
🛡️ Or DEFEND: grab your wrench, run the firewall, and smack hackers off your plot! 🔧

🕶️ Visit the SMUGGLER in his cave… his crates hide the rarest machines in the game! 📦🍀
🔄 REBIRTH to release your AI v2, v3, v4… every version trains FASTER! 🚀

💤 Your AI keeps earning while you're OFFLINE!

👍 Like & join the group for FREE crates + a FREE respec! 🎁
🔔 Follow for updates! New hardware tiers coming soon!
